_comment: Optional control-state. Copy to config.json and pass with --config. Every field is optional; omitted fields fall back to the built-in defaults (which reproduce the source workbook). The two DATA files (inventory + sales) are passed on the command line, not here.
_prev_loaners_comment: Units back from demo duty. 'since' is when they returned to sellable inventory (appeared publicly); the engine ages them from there, not the inflated days-in-stock, so a returned loaner isn't wrongly wholesaled the moment it reappears.
_trades_comment: Outbound dealer trades. Each is a sale out the other door; 'days' is days-in-stock at trade (grades speed to enter/exit inventory). date drives recency (R90/R180).
